scope.intended_use: Dentist teaching asset specification; no clinical or anatomical approval

component_catalog.label: Tooth exterior / 牙体外表面
component_catalog.spec: Whole-tooth segmentation envelope; an exterior proxy, not an enamel mesh.

component_catalog.label: Enamel / 牙釉质
component_catalog.spec: Crown tissue; preserve individual cusp/ridge/fossa morphology. No uniform offset shell as source truth.

component_catalog.label: Dentin / 牙本质
component_catalog.spec: Separate crown/root tissue surrounding the pulp space; do not infer thickness from exterior alone.

component_catalog.label: Cementum / 牙骨质
component_catalog.spec: Root covering; unresolved thin layers remain unavailable or explicitly schematic.

component_catalog.label: Pulp / 牙髓
component_catalog.spec: Soft tissue distinct from a cavity mask; no fabricated nerves or vessels.

component_catalog.label: Pulp cavity / 牙髓腔
component_catalog.spec: Segmentation-derived space proxy; does not prove separate pulp tissue or canal branches.

component_catalog.label: Pulp chamber / 髓室
component_catalog.spec: Coronal subdivision of pulp cavity, only after supported boundary review.

component_catalog.label: Root canals / 根管
component_catalog.spec: Named specimen-specific branches; variable count/course, never fixed from tooth class alone.

component_catalog.label: Periodontal ligament / 牙周膜
component_catalog.spec: Tooth-associated support between cementum and socket; do not render unresolved thickness as measured anatomy.

component_catalog.label: Anatomical crown / 解剖牙冠
component_catalog.spec: Region annotation, not a new overlapping tissue solid.

component_catalog.label: Roots / 牙根
component_catalog.spec: Named observed roots; specimen-specific count, furcation and resorption status.

component_catalog.label: Cementoenamel junction / 釉牙骨质界
component_catalog.spec: Boundary landmark, not a volumetric tissue.

component_catalog.label: Apical foramina / 根尖孔
component_catalog.spec: Observed openings only; no assertion that every fine branch is resolved.

component_catalog.label: Surface landmarks / 牙面标志
component_catalog.spec: Mesial/distal; buccal or labial; lingual or palatal; occlusal/incisal; named cusps, ridges, grooves and fossae where applicable.

shared_support_catalog.spec: Separately selectable free/attached gingiva and interdental papilla annotations where supported; do not duplicate shared papillae per tooth.
Arch-level support mesh; tooth-specific socket regions are annotations, not overlapping duplicate bone.
Maxilla or mandible context; whole jaw segmentation is not a separately validated alveolar process.

coverage_policy.synthetic_details: Separate schematic layer with explicit label and rationale; never silently source-derived

condition_catalog.spec: Separate lesion volume/mask and affected tissue states; localized enamel/dentin examples. Do not imply color alone diagnoses extent.
Separate cavity preparation, restoration and intact baseline variants; composite/amalgam material labels without invented measured properties.
Independent plaque/calculus deposits, gingival inflammation/recession, pocket and bone-loss examples; geometry-supported disease extent, not universal severity staging.
Separate annotated pulp inflammation/necrosis and periapical lesion examples; visual teaching states require new pathology-specific references and expert review.
Crack annotation or actual fracture plane/fragments depending on evidence; no visible line claimed as definitive fracture depth. Dedicated reference needed.
Tooth position, eruption context and surrounding bone/soft tissue as separate objects; dedicated case/reference and registration needed.
Socket/ridge and implant-restoration assembly variants; no implied patient-specific implant planning.

tool_asset_contract.units: meters in GLB; measured source dimensions recorded in mm
tool_asset_contract.frame_status: named placeholders only until verified geometry exists
tool_asset_contract.device_policy: Generic non-branded placeholders in spec. Realistic geometry needs source/reference and redistribution clearance. Do not average incompatible device systems.

space_semantics.pulp_cavity: Parent space/render proxy, not verified tissue
space_semantics.partition_policy: Child regions partition or annotate parent; no duplicate overlapping volume totals or simultaneous duplicate solids
space_semantics.tissue_overlay: pulp_tissue is a distinct evidentiary claim, unavailable until independently supported
